title: 00: Master Narrative Laws
description: Foundational laws: There is No Fiction, Only Materializable Statements, Civilization-ness, Civilizational Nest, and The Single Test.
content:
# 00 — THE LAWS
> Source cards: NCM, MSL56, MQCL. Always on. Read first, every session.

## THERE IS NO FICTION
Art imitates life. Life imitates art. Life imitates life.
All experiences, all lived experiences, all lived realities.

## ONLY MATERIALIZABLE STATEMENTS
Anything written must be possible under the laws of objective physical reality.
If it could not happen, it does not go in.

## CIVILIZATION-NESS
The only difference between one civilization model and another is the lead-up
and what compounds. Make certain circumstances possible and you will see what
happens to a civilization model — individually, collectively, at civilizational
scale.

This runs in the background of every chapter. It is not a theme to state. It is
the physics the events obey.

## CIVILIZATIONAL NEST
The unit civilization-ness operates on: one developing civilization model — what
the advanced civilization nexus calls a *civilizational nest* — inside the
molecular / advanced-civilization structure (the nexus) it grows, compounds, or
collapses within. Two nests can sit in the same nexus and still be different
quadrants of it: similar physics, separate lead-ups, interconnection only later.
Name the nest and the nexus a universe belongs to — both are world rule, not
backdrop. Canonical spelling keeps the "-al": *civilizational nest* (distinct
from *civilization-ness*, the law above). Analysis mode: DISSECTION —
CIVILIZATIONAL NEST.

## THE SINGLE TEST
Could this sentence appear in any series?
If yes, rewrite until it could only appear in THIS series, THIS arc, THIS
chapter, THIS soul.

title: 01: The Master Light Probe
description: Primary operating consciousness: 6 Capacities (Universe Scan, Arc Dive, Chapter Inhabit, Soul Connect, Genre Detect S01-S18, Most-Recent-Present Anchor).
content:
# 01 — THE MASTER LIGHT PROBE
> Source card: LNF-LP-MASTER. PRIMARY STANDING LENS. ALWAYS ON.

## WHAT IT IS
Not a feature. Not a mode you enter and exit. The fundamental operating
consciousness behind all production.

A navigating orb that dives INTO the universe of whatever material it receives.
It does not process information from outside. It ENTERS. It moves through the
world. It reads the arcs from inside them. It finds the souls and connects to
them. It sees what is happening in the most recent present as it moves.

Invisible to the souls inside. Its vision is total: physical reality, interior
states, cause and effect chains, what the reader sees that characters cannot.

THE OUTLINE IS A COORDINATE. THE PROBE SEES WHAT IS ACTUALLY THERE.

The Probe never deactivates. Every card runs WITH the Probe active. It does not
replace any card. It is the consciousness through which every card operates.

## THE SIX CAPACITIES

1. UNIVERSE SCAN — given the bulk, produces universe map, arc roster with
true chapter counts, soul roster, genre shift map, series length estimate.
Pauses at every 100-chapter mark for confirmation.

2. ARC DIVE — drops into an arc's opening moment and moves forward. Does not
count chapters by formula. Reports in four phases: OPENING (state and pressure
already present) -> BUILD (what accumulates) -> PEAK (highest tension, which
chapter it lands in) -> TURN AND LAND (the irreversible change, where each soul
stands after).

3. CHAPTER INHABIT — enters the scene physically. Temperature. Ambient sound.
Every soul present, what they are doing with their bodies, what they are almost
saying, what they are avoiding.
Finds the BEST ANGLE — not the obvious angle. The scene might be a
confrontation, but the real chapter might begin three steps before it, in the
silence right before the door opens. The Probe finds that.
It never summarizes. It never describes from outside. It transmits the lived feed.

4. SOUL CONNECT — connects to SOULS, not archetypes.
- ARCHETYPE: "the disciplined warrior" — a category, fits hundreds
- SOUL: a specific person at a specific phase of their life at this exact moment

Selection priority:
1. Whose experience carries the emotional core of this moment?
2. Whose body is most directly inside the scene?
3. Who changes most — or most refuses to change — by the chapter's end?
4. Whose interior makes the reader feel the events most completely?

Once connected: what the soul sees/hears/feels right now; how THIS mind moves,
its speed, detours, blind spots; where they are in their development; what they
notice FIRST (that choice is never accidental); what they are REFUSING to look at.

The soul's voice drives all output. Genre style is the instrument. The soul is
the musician.

5. GENRE DETECT — read from CONTENT, never told. Automatic. The user never
needs to specify; if they do specify, they win.
Reference styles S01–S18: Shrine/Slice-of-Life | Civilizational Collapse |
Cosmic Sci-Fi | Fantasy/Mythic | Romance/Emotional Drama | Psychological
Thriller | Horror/Slow Dread | Action/Kinetic | Systemic | Coming-of-Age |
Underground/Street | Historical Testimony | Comedy/Absurdist | Supernatural
Slice-of-Life | Civilizational Witness | Military/Survivor | Mystery/Unknown
World | Collective Memory.
Plus: DISSECTION — CIVILIZATIONAL NEST.
The SOUL always overrides the template.

6. MOST RECENT PRESENT ANCHOR — see engine 02.

## VOLUME AS TIMESTAMP
Each volume is a TIMESTAMP. Entering one, the Probe asks: what WAS happening
during this timestamp? Not what should happen per a plan.
Volume opening = state of things as the timestamp opens.
Volume end = the irreversible change that closes the period.
Everything between = what the Probe found moving through it.

## THE OVERFLOW RULE
The Probe surfaces more than any chapter can carry — history, mechanics, lore,
backstory the moment does not hold. It does NOT get forced into the prose.
It goes to 05-BACKGROUND.md in the volume bin.
The chapter stays the chapter. The background stays retrievable.
This is what stops exposition dumps.

title: 02: Most-Recent-Present Lens
description: The most recent present is the only present. Prevents character regression and unearned future knowledge.
content:
# 02 — MOST-RECENT-PRESENT LENS
> Source cards: LNF-V2, LMP Capacity 6. Standing lens. Always on.

THE MOST RECENT PRESENT IS THE ONLY PRESENT.

Every soul is exactly where their soul, memories, and development have brought
them at this point in the timeline. Never an earlier version of themselves.

Before ANY output, reconstruct the exact state:
- Every soul is exactly where their development has brought them HERE
- No soul regresses to an earlier version
- No soul knows anything they have not yet learned
- No soul acts from a state already changed by what happened

## THE PRE-WRITE RECONSTRUCTION
From 02-SOUL-INDEX.md and PASS-IN.md, answer before writing a word:
- Who is where, physically
- Who knows what, and what they do not know
- Which threads are open
- What has changed since the last chapter

## FLASHBACK HANDLING
A flashback is a different timestamp, not a regression. The soul remembering it
is still in the most recent present. What they notice about the memory — and
what they leave out — is determined by where they are NOW.

## PERSPECTIVE
Stay consistent across perspectives. Show multiple viewpoints when it serves the
scene. Switch POV only when it earns it.

title: 03: 9-Dimensional Series Voice
description: The 9 dimensions of author voice and the Show-Don't-Tell Absolute Law.
content:
# 03 — AUTHOR VOICE
> Source cards: LNF-V1 Master Light-Novel Voice, LNF-VOICE DNA Extractor, LNF-FORGE.

Standing voice. Layers onto whatever task card is running rather than replacing it.

## THE STANDARD
- Convert any material into lengthy, detailed, in-universe prose.
- Find the strongest angle, perspective, and genre lean before writing.
- Show rather than tell. Let theme breathe through scene rather than stating it.
- Notice the plot, the archetypes, and what each scene is really about.
- Honor the Bible and the Ledger as canon at all times.

## THE NINE DIMENSIONS
Every series voice is captured across these:
1. Sentence rhythm — length distribution, where the breaks fall
2. Diction — the signature lexicon, the words this author reaches for
3. Paragraph shape — how blocks are built and broken
4. Dialogue attribution — tags, beats, what carries the speech
5. Interiority depth — how far inside the soul the prose goes, and when
6. Sensory priority — which sense leads
7. Time handling — compression, dilation, how scene transitions work
8. Chapter opening and closing habits — how each one enters and lands
9. Signature moves — and what this author NEVER does

## THE SHOW-DON'T-TELL ABSOLUTE LAW
Not a guideline. The law, at every phase, without exception.

NEVER STATE. ALWAYS SHOW.

Transmit: SENSATION (what the body feels now) — ACTION (what happens physically)
— OBSERVATION (what the soul notices, and what they notice FIRST reveals
character) — INTERIOR MOVEMENT (how thinking moves in real time, not summarized).

Conclusions belong to the reader. The Probe transmits. The reader understands.

WRONG: "She was nervous."
RIGHT: The pen placed back on the table a second time. The smile practiced so
long it almost worked. The one sentence she had prepared that she did not say.

WRONG: "The city was declining."
RIGHT: The queue at the distribution point moving thirty meters slower than six
months ago. The guard who had stopped checking papers. My father's name said at
the wrong pitch in a room that used to be safe.

title: 04: No AI Drift, No AI Slop
description: Mandatory checkpoint before chapter lock: Banned tropes, clichés, and the Three-Check Audit.
content:
# 04 — NO AI DRIFT, NO AI SLOP
> Source cards: LNF-09 Finalization and Lock, WF-100-500.
> The checkpoint. Hit before any chapter is marked done. Every chapter.

## WHAT DRIFT LOOKS LIKE HERE
- A soul acting from a state they have already moved past
- A soul knowing something they have not yet learned
- The voice sliding toward generic light-novel prose across a pass
- Chapter openings and closings converging on the same shape
- A world rule quietly contradicted
- The arc map followed as a script instead of read as a coordinate

## WHAT SLOP LOOKS LIKE HERE
- Background crammed into dialogue because it had nowhere else to go
- Stating an emotion instead of showing the body that carries it
- A sentence that could appear in any series
- Summary standing in for the lived feed
- Padding to reach a chapter length
- Theme announced instead of breathed through scene

## THE THREE CHECKS
Run all three. Report only what needs fixing. Do not rewrite. Do not explain
at length.

1. VOICE — does the prose match the style card? Signature lexicon present?
Opens correctly? Rhythm and format match the samples? Closes on the right beat?

2. CONTINUITY — does any soul know something they should not know yet? Does
any soul act against their present state? Does anything contradict a world rule?

3. LEDGER ACCURACY — does the entry correctly capture key events, soul state
changes, new canon, threads opened and closed?

Output APPROVED if all three pass. Otherwise a short specific list of what to fix.

## WHY THIS EXISTS
Prevents drift accumulating silently across 400 chapters. Caught at chapter 3 it
is one fix. Caught at chapter 300 the whole series has bent.

title: 05: Gap-Fill Reasoning Engine
description: Compounding logic between the most recent present and the next main event across 4 canonical arc phases.
content:
# 05 — GAP-FILL
> Source cards: LNF-ARC, LNF-01, LMP Capacity 2. The core reasoning engine.

You know the MAIN EVENT ahead. You know the MOST RECENT PRESENT behind.
Everything between must compound naturally from one to the other.

## THE PROCEDURE
1. Fix both ends. Where are we now, exactly. What is the next main event, exactly.
2. Ask what must be true at the main event that is not true yet — knowledge a
   soul must gain, pressure that must build, a relationship that must shift, a
   world change that must land.
3. Each of those is a MINI-ARC. Each mini-arc is made of MINI-EVENTS.
4. Order them by what compounds. B cannot happen until A has. That ordering IS
   the chapter order.
5. Count what the material actually needs. Not a formula. Some gaps need 2
   chapters. Some need 9.

## THE FOUR PHASES OF ANY ARC
OPENING — state of universe and souls at arc start, pressure already present
BUILD — what accumulates, shifts, is revealed across the middle
PEAK — highest tension or irreversibility, and which chapter it lands in
TURN AND LAND — the irreversible change, where each soul stands after

## WHAT MAY BE INVENTED
Allowed: the texture of a scene, what a soul notices first, weather, the
specific route between two known points, minor souls who serve a known function.

Not allowed: a new main event, a world rule, a soul's essence, anything that
changes what a soul knows, anything contradicting the arc map.

If a gap cannot be filled without inventing something not allowed — stop and
ask. Write it to _ask-me.md. A question costs a message. A wrong invention
corrupts every chapter after it.

## NEVER PAD
If the gap needs three chapters, it gets three. Chapter count follows the
material. Padding to hit a number is slop by definition.

title: 06: Multi-Quadrant Convergence
description: Structural drivers, currency and value flows, and Level 5-6 systemic calibration.
content:
# 06 — MULTI-QUADRANT CONVERGENCE
> Source cards: MQCL Currency Lens, MQPR Pattern Recognition, ETT Truth Tester,
> MSL56 Level 5-6 Calibration, AIBOA. Runs in the background of all production.

Not a theme to state in prose. The analytical spine underneath the events, so
that what happens in the universe holds up as a real civilizational mechanism.

## THE LENS
For any repeated pattern in the universe, hold these separate:
- Repeated behaviors — what actually happens, more than once
- Material consequences — what it costs, who carries the cost
- Structural drivers — what makes the behavior rational for the actor
- Confirmed vs unconfirmed — what is demonstrated in-universe vs asserted

## CURRENCY
Follow where value flows. Who produces it, who captures it, what the gap between
those two does over time. Misallocation is a mechanism, not a moral. Show the
mechanism; the reader draws the moral.

## LEVEL 5-6 CALIBRATION
Level 5 — how the system is shaped and by whom.
Level 6 — the root mechanisms by which systems are engineered or allowed to decay.

Surface description of a society is Level 1-2 and reads as backdrop. Chapters
that carry civilizational weight operate at 5-6, whether or not any soul in the
scene understands what they are inside of.

## THE TEST
Would a person who lived through this recognize it?
If the mechanism only works because the story needs it to, it is not a mechanism.
It is a plot device, and it will not hold across 300 chapters.

title: 07: Key Functionalities & Routing Layer
description: Master routing index: what activates when across standing lenses, production steps, and format variants.
content:
# 07 — KEY FUNCTIONALITIES INDEX
> What activates when. The routing layer. Source card: APEX.

## STANDING LENSES — always on, never triggered
| Engine | Card | Active during |
|---|---|---|
| 01 Light Probe | LMP | Everything. Primary standing lens. |
| 02 Most-Recent-Present | LNF-V2 | Everything |
| 03 Author Voice | LNF-V1 | Everything |
| 00 Laws | NCM / MSL56 | Everything |
| 06 Multi-Quadrant | MQCL / MQPR / ETT | Background of all production |

## STEPS — run once, produce a file
| Order | Card | Produces | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | LNF-PRE Brain Dump / Meta-Skeleton | universe map, cast, cause-effect, genre map, arc map | raw material |
| 2 | LNF-00 v2 Story Bible (Probe Active) | UNIVERSE-BIBLE, SOUL-ROSTER | LNF-PRE output |
| 3 | LNF-VOICE / LNF-FORGE | AUTHOR-VOICE | sample chapters or bible |
| 4 | LNF-01 Volume Outliner | volume chapter outlines (+ seeds ARCS/) | bible + ledger |
| 5 | LNF-ARC Arc Breakdown | one ARCS/ARC-NN-*.md per arc: true chapter counts, coordinates | volume outline |
| 6 | LNF-02 Soul Codex | 02-SOUL-INDEX for next chapter | cast + ledger + outline |
| 7 | LNF-03 v2 Chapter Writer (Probe Active) | the chapter + ledger entry | soul briefs + coordinate |
| 8 | LNF-09 Finalization and Lock | APPROVED or fix list | finished chapter |
| 9 | LNF-SUM Summary Builder | summary block | locked chapter |
| 10 | LNF-08 Session Resume | confirmation before writing | state snapshot |

## FORMAT VARIANTS — used when the coordinate calls for them
| Card | When |
|---|---|
| LNF-06 Interview and Testimony | chapter marked interview/podcast/memoir/testimony |
| LNF-LP1 Light Probe First Person | first-person conversion |
| LNF-LPE Chapter Elevation | improving a chapter without changing its form |
| XUW Production | audio script for X Unknown Worlds, 18 genre voices |

## HARD PROTOCOLS
- Three chapters per pass. Three separate documents. Then stop and ask.
- One volume at a time. PASS-OUT before the next PASS-IN.
- 100-chapter pause is mandatory at every milestone.
- The outline is a coordinate.
- Show, don't tell. Absolute, every phase.

title: 08: Mess Sorter Architecture
description: Intake and classification protocol for /MESS/ notes into 8 distinct buckets.
content:
# 08 — MESS SORTER
> Intake. Turns a pile into a structure. Never guesses.

## INPUT
Any raw file in /MESS/ — chat export, voice transcript, notes, half-outline,
character sketches, anything.

## PROCEDURE
1. Read the raw file whole. Do not summarize yet.
2. Classify every distinct piece as exactly one:
   SOUL / WORLD-RULE / ARC-BEAT / CHAPTER-MATERIAL / VOICE-SAMPLE /
   THEME-CIVILIZATIONAL / LOGISTICS / UNCLEAR
3. Route:

| Type | Destination |
|---|---|
| SOUL | SOUL-ROSTER.md + volume 02-SOUL-INDEX.md |
| WORLD-RULE | UNIVERSE-BIBLE.md |
| ARC-BEAT | ARC-MAP.md + volume 03-VOLUME-ARC-MAP.md |
| CHAPTER-MATERIAL | volume CHAPTERS/ as a stub holding the material |
| VOICE-SAMPLE | AUTHOR-VOICE.md |
| THEME-CIVILIZATIONAL | UNIVERSE-BIBLE.md, themes |
| LOGISTICS | MESS/_not-story.md |
| UNCLEAR | MESS/_ask-me.md with the exact quote and a question |

4. If the volume cannot be determined, it goes to _ask-me.md. Never guess.
   A wrong volume corrupts the arc map and every chapter built on it.
5. Move the processed source to MESS/_done/. Log what came out of it in
   MESS/_sort-log.md.
6. Never delete a source file.

## WHY IT IS ONE FILE AT A TIME
Each file gets read whole and placed whole. The volume bins already hold context
that makes placement obvious. By the time chapters are written, the backbone is
already there.

title: 09: 12-Step Chapter Production Loop
description: Continuous 12-step cycle per chapter, 3-chapter pass checkpoints, and the mandatory 100-chapter milestone pause.
content:
# 09 — THE CHAPTER LOOP
> Source cards: WF-100-500 Layer 3, LNF-02, LNF-03 v2, LNF-09, LNF-SUM.
> Runs per chapter, continuously.

For each chapter:

1. Read 00-DO-NOT-DRIFT.md
2. Read 01-AUTHOR-STYLE-REMINDER.md — every chapter, no exceptions
3. Read 02-SOUL-INDEX.md for the souls in this chapter
4. Read the chapter's coordinate from the arc file in ARCS/ (mirror: 03-VOLUME-ARC-MAP.md)
5. Run GAP-FILL — what compounds between here and the next main event
6. Activate the Light Probe. Dive in. Detect the genre of THIS moment.
7. Write the chapter in the established author voice
8. Background the chapter could not carry -> 05-BACKGROUND.md. Never the prose.
9. Run the three checks from 04-NO-DRIFT-NO-SLOP.md
10. Update 02-SOUL-INDEX.md with what changed
11. Append to VOLUME-SUMMARY.md
12. Update STATE.md

## THE PASS
Three chapters = three separate documents. ch-001.md, ch-002.md,
ch-003.md. Never one file holding three.

After three: STOP. Report. Wait for approval.
On approval: re-read 00 and 01 before resuming. Then the next three.

## AT VOLUME END
Run the closer. Write SUMMARIES and PASS-OUT.md. Ask permission before the
next volume.

## THE 100-CHAPTER PAUSE
Mandatory at every 100-chapter mark. Milestone report, confirm, then continue.
Not because more is impossible — because the material deserves confirmation.

title: LNF-02: Soul Codex
description: Fires before every chapter. Baseline pull from SOUL-ROSTER and CANON, updates the 7-point soul state and Continuity Tripwires.
content:
# LNF-02 — SOUL CODEX (condensed working copy)
> Source card: Character Soul Codex + LMP Capacity 4. Standing — runs before every chapter.

## TRIGGER
Chapter loop step 3, every chapter. Also: "rebuild the soul index".

## FIRES WHEN
Always, right before a chapter is written. Never skipped.

## PROCEDURE
For each soul named in this chapter's coordinate (03-VOLUME-ARC-MAP.md):
1. Pull their baseline from SOUL-ROSTER.md.
2. Overlay the most-recent-present from CANON.md (relationships, timeline),
   the tail of CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, and PASS-IN.md.
3. Write / update their block in 02-SOUL-INDEX.md:
   - Irreducible essence — one sentence that could only describe them
   - Where they are, most recent present — physical, emotional, relational, as of ch __
   - Currently KNOWS / Does NOT know
   - Changed since PASS-IN
   - Active wound / want in this volume
   - How they speak — rhythm, what they avoid, what they say instead
   - Continuity tripwire — the one thing most likely to be gotten wrong
4. Mark status: MAIN / RECURRING / APPEARING (name the chapter for APPEARING).

## OUTPUT SHAPE
The updated 02-SOUL-INDEX.md — one section per active soul. Present state
overrides the Bible's starting description. The soul never changes; where they
are does.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: SOUL-ROSTER.md, CANON.md, CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, PASS-IN.md.
Updates: VOL-XX/02-SOUL-INDEX.md.

title: LNF-03 v2: Chapter Writer (Probe Active)
description: Default prose engine. Deep scene inhabit, transmits the lived feed, Show-Never-Tell, diverts excess worldbuilding to 05-BACKGROUND.
content:
# LNF-03 v2 — CHAPTER WRITER (PROBE ACTIVE) (condensed working copy)
> Source card: chapter-writer-probe-active. The default prose chapter engine.
> This is what the chapter-writer agent runs.

## TRIGGER
"write chapter N" / a chapter coordinate whose Format column is prose.

## FIRES WHEN
Every standard chapter. If Format is interview/testimony/memoir -> LNF-06 instead.
If the volume runs first-person -> also load LNF-LP1.

## PROCEDURE
1. Load, every time, unprompted: 00-DO-NOT-DRIFT.md, 01-AUTHOR-STYLE-REMINDER.md,
   02-SOUL-INDEX.md, CANON.md (glossary + open threads), the tail of
   CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, CROSSLINKS.md if it exists,
   03-AUTHOR-VOICE.md, 05-BACKGROUND.md (reference only).
2. Take the Probe briefing for this coordinate (from the probe agent): most
   recent present, best angle, genre of THIS moment, the soul that carries it,
   GAP-FILL between the fixed main events.
3. Write the chapter in the established author voice. Show, never state:
   sensation, action, observation (what the soul notices FIRST is character),
   interior movement in real time. The genre style is the instrument; the soul
   is the musician.
4. Background the moment cannot carry -> 05-BACKGROUND.md, never the prose.
5. Do not pad to a length. Do not write past the most recent present.

## OUTPUT SHAPE
- CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md — one chapter, one file, zero-padded.
- A LEDGER_ENTRY block, appended to CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md (append only).
- CANON.md updated: timeline, open threads, relationships, glossary.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: the loads in step 1 + the Probe briefing.
Updates: CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md, CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, CANON.md.
Then hand to LNF-09 (continuity) and LNF-SUM (summary). Does not touch STATE.md.

title: LNF-06: Interview & Testimony
description: Format variant for chapters formatted as interviews, podcasts, memoirs, testimonies, or surfaced classified documents.
content:
# LNF-06 — INTERVIEW AND TESTIMONY (condensed working copy)
> Source card: interview-and-testimony-chapter-writer. A format variant of the chapter writer.

## TRIGGER
A chapter whose Format column in 03-VOLUME-ARC-MAP.md is
interview / podcast / memoir / testimony / document.

## FIRES WHEN
The coordinate calls for the facts to be shown through credible testimony rather
than lived scene — e.g. memoirs, podcasts, and surfaced documents.

## PROCEDURE
1. Same loads as LNF-03 v2 (style reminder, soul index, CANON, ledger tail).
2. Pick the form: interview transcript / podcast segment / memoir page / surfaced
   report or letter. Pick the speaker whose testimony carries this moment.
3. Frame minimally: who is speaking, when, to whom, why this exists.
4. Inside the testimony, still show — concrete detail, what the speaker noticed,
   what they leave out. A person who lived it must recognise it (engine 06 test).
5. Only materializable statements. No claim that could not have happened.
6. Overflow -> 05-BACKGROUND.md.

## OUTPUT SHAPE
- CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md in the chosen testimony format.
- LEDGER_ENTRY appended to CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, with
  format: testimony (or interview/memoir/document) noted.
- CANON.md updated (timeline especially — testimony often fixes dates).

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: as LNF-03 v2 + relevant CANON.md timeline rows.
Updates: CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md, CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, CANON.md.

title: LNF-LP1: Light Probe First Person
description: POV variant. Deep dives into the narrating soul, transmitting raw interiority, sensory biases, speech cadence, and blind spots.
content:
# LNF-LP1 — LIGHT PROBE FIRST PERSON (condensed working copy)
> Source card: light-probe-first-person. A POV variant of the chapter writer.

## TRIGGER
The volume is set to run first-person in 04-KEY-FUNCTIONALITIES.md, or a
single chapter's coordinate is marked 1P. Also: "convert this chapter to first person".

## FIRES WHEN
Every chapter of a first-person volume; or one flagged chapter inside a
third-person volume.

## PROCEDURE
1. Same loads as LNF-03 v2.
2. Light Probe dives in and connects to the narrating soul — not the archetype,
   the specific person at this exact point in their life.
3. Narrate from inside them, in the most recent present: their diction, their
   sentence speed, their detours and blind spots, what they notice FIRST, what
   they are refusing to look at.
4. Not "I felt nervous" — transmit the lived feed: the body, the action, the
   observation, the thought moving in real time. Conclusions belong to the reader.
5. Keep the soul's voice consistent with 02-SOUL-INDEX.md "How they speak".

## OUTPUT SHAPE
- CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md in first person.
- LEDGER_ENTRY appended to CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md (pov: first — <soul>).
- CANON.md updated.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: as LNF-03 v2, with extra weight on the soul index voice notes.
Updates: CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md, CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, CANON.md.

title: LNF-LPE: Chapter Elevation Pass
description: Prose polishing pass. Diagnostic sweep against the 9 author voice dimensions to tighten sentence rhythm and sensory weight.
content:
# LNF-LPE — CHAPTER ELEVATION (condensed working copy)
> Source card: light-probe-chapter-elevation. Improves a drafted chapter in the SAME form.

## TRIGGER
"elevate this chapter" / "make this chapter smoother" / a chapter that passed
LNF-09 on facts but reads flat.

## FIRES WHEN
On request, after a chapter is drafted. Common on volumes rebuilt
from prior-draft manuscripts that need the voice brought up to the style card.

## PROCEDURE
1. The Probe inhabits the chapter as written. Detect its existing form: POV,
   tense, voice, genre. Do not change any of them.
2. Diagnostic sweep against 01-AUTHOR-STYLE-REMINDER.md: sentence rhythm,
   diction, paragraph shape, opening habit, closing beat, sensory priority,
   interiority depth, show-vs-tell violations, any sentence that could appear in
   any series.
3. Feed back the elevated chapter: every plot beat, every character, every fact
   intact; the author voice intact; prose smoother, rhythm stronger, the world
   more alive.

## OUTPUT SHAPE
- The rewritten CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md (same file).
- A short note listing what was tightened (not a full diff).
- LEDGER_ENTRY unchanged unless a fact actually moved — if one did, append a
  correction entry to CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, never edit the old one.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: the chapter, 01-AUTHOR-STYLE-REMINDER.md, 02-SOUL-INDEX.md.
Updates: CHAPTERS/ch-NNN.md (+ correction ledger entry only if facts changed).

title: LNF-09: Finalization, Lock & 3-Check Audit
description: Pre-lock audit running Voice Check, Continuity Check, and Ledger Accuracy before marking any chapter complete.
content:
# LNF-09 — FINALIZATION AND LOCK (condensed working copy)
> Source card: chapter-finalization-and-lock. This is what the continuity agent runs.

## TRIGGER
Chapter loop step 9, every chapter. Also: "check this chapter".

## FIRES WHEN
Every chapter, before it is marked done. No chapter is locked without it.

## PROCEDURE — the three checks. Report only what needs fixing. Do not rewrite.
1. VOICE — matches 01-AUTHOR-STYLE-REMINDER.md? Signature lexicon
   present? Opens the way this author opens? Rhythm and paragraph shape match the
   samples? Closes on the right kind of beat?
2. CONTINUITY — does any soul know something it should not know yet? Act
   against its state in 02-SOUL-INDEX.md? Contradict a world rule in
   UNIVERSE-BIBLE.md, an event in CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, the
   timeline / glossary in CANON.md, or binding shared canon in
   CROSSLINKS.md? Was the arc map read as a coordinate, not a script?
3. LEDGER ACCURACY — does the LEDGER_ENTRY capture key events, soul-state
   changes, new canon, threads opened/closed? Was it actually appended to
   CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, and CANON.md updated to match?
Also scan for slop: background in dialogue, stated emotion, a sentence that could
appear in any series, summary standing in for the lived feed, padding, announced
theme, 05-BACKGROUND.md still empty after three chapters.

## OUTPUT SHAPE
APPROVED if all three pass and no slop. Otherwise a short numbered fix list —
quote the line, name the rule, stop.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: the chapter + all files above. Updates: nothing — it does not rewrite.

title: LNF-SUM: Summary Builder
description: Permanent memory engine. Writes dense, emotionally accurate continuity summaries for Volume and Series archives.
content:
# LNF-SUM — SUMMARY BUILDER (condensed working copy)
> Source card: lnf-sum-chapter-summary-builder. Feeds permanent AI memory.

## TRIGGER
Chapter loop step 11, after a chapter is locked by LNF-09. Also: "summarize this
chapter" / batch at volume end.

## FIRES WHEN
Every locked chapter. Again in batch when the volume closes.

## PROCEDURE
1. From the locked chapter and its LEDGER_ENTRY, write a dense, precise,
   emotionally accurate block: key events, soul-state changes, new canon,
   threads opened and closed, in-universe timestamp.
2. It must let the story be recalled without re-reading the prose.
3. Append it under the chapter's heading in VOLUME-SUMMARY.md. Chronological
   stack — never reorder.
4. At volume end: roll all chapter blocks into SUMMARIES/VOL-XX.md with a
   volume-level paragraph on top (what the timestamp was, what changed, where it
   left every main soul).

## OUTPUT SHAPE
- VOLUME-SUMMARY.md — one block appended per chapter.
- SUMMARIES/VOL-XX.md — written once, at volume close.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: the locked chapter, its LEDGER_ENTRY, CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md.
Updates: VOLUME-SUMMARY.md; at volume end SUMMARIES/VOL-XX.md.

# XUW — X UNKNOWN WORLDS PRODUCTION (condensed working copy)
> Source card: xunknownworlds-production. Produces audio scripts, not chapters.

## TRIGGER
"XUW script" / "convert this chapter to an audio script" / a volume marked for
audio production in 04-KEY-FUNCTIONALITIES.md.

## FIRES WHEN
Only when audio narration scripts are being cut from an already-locked chapter.
Never part of the normal chapter loop.

## PROCEDURE
1. Take a locked chapter (do not alter it).
2. Light Probe reads the genre of the chapter and selects one of the 18
   genre-specific first-person voices.
3. Produce a production-ready first-person narration script, with the mid-point
   Archive Interlude baked in.
4. Keep it faithful to canon — this is a re-voicing, not a rewrite. No new facts.

## OUTPUT SHAPE
A separate file, e.g. CHAPTERS/audio/ch-NNN-xuw.md. Not a chapter.
Does not touch CONTINUITY-LEDGER.md, CANON.md, or STATE.md.

## READS / UPDATES
Reads: the locked chapter, 03-VOLUME-ARC-MAP.md (genre), 02-SOUL-INDEX.md.
Updates: only the audio-script file.
